description: A PostHog insight alert: checks an insight's value on a schedule against a threshold (or an anomaly detector) and notifies subscribed users when it fires. Runtime state (state, last checked/notified, check history) is not part of the resource.

Type.description: Whether bounds are compared as `absolute` values or as `percentage` change from the previous interval.

Bounds.description: Lower and upper bounds. For threshold-based alerts (no DetectorConfig) at least one must be set.

Lower.description: The alert fires when the value drops below this number.

Upper.description: The alert fires when the value exceeds this number.

Type.description: How the value is evaluated: `absolute_value`, `relative_increase` or `relative_decrease`.

BlockedWindows.description: Local time windows (project timezone) when the alert must not run. At most five.

Start.description: Start time HH:MM (24-hour, project timezone), inclusive.

End.description: End time HH:MM (24-hour, project timezone), exclusive. Each window must span at least 30 minutes.

ApiKey.description: PostHog personal API key (phx_...) with the scopes this resource type needs. Pass it with a dynamic reference such as {{resolve:ssm-secure:/posthog/api-key}} when calling SetTypeConfiguration; never put it in plain text.

BaseUrl.description: PostHog API host. Leave unset for PostHog Cloud US (https://us.posthog.com); use https://eu.posthog.com for PostHog Cloud EU, or your instance URL when self-hosting.

ProjectId.description: ID of the PostHog project the alert belongs to.

InsightId.description: ID of the insight (PostHog::ProductAnalytics::Insight) the alert monitors.

SubscribedUsers.description: IDs of the PostHog users notified when the alert fires.

Threshold.description: Threshold configuration with bounds and type for evaluating the alert.

Condition.description: How the insight value is evaluated against the threshold.

Enabled.description: Whether the alert is actively being evaluated. Defaults to true.

CalculationInterval.description: How often the alert is checked: `real_time` (Scale+), `every_15_minutes` (Boost+), `hourly`, `daily`, `weekly` or `monthly`.

Config.description: Per-insight-kind alert configuration as JSON (use Fn::ToJsonString), discriminated by `type`, e.g. {"type": "TrendsAlertConfig", "series_index": 0, "check_ongoing_interval": false}.

DetectorConfig.description: Anomaly detector configuration as JSON (use Fn::ToJsonString), discriminated by `type` (zscore, mad, iqr, threshold, ecod, copod, isolation_forest, knn, hbos, lof, ocsvm, pca, ensemble, forecast, llm, ...). When set, the detector decides when the alert fires instead of the threshold bounds.

EvaluationDelayIntervals.description: Skip this many completed insight intervals after excluding the ongoing interval (0-100). Time-series Trends only; a positive delay requires check_ongoing_interval false.

ScheduleStartTime.description: Local time (HH:MM) that starts alert checks.

SkipWeekend.description: Skip alert evaluation on Saturdays and Sundays (project timezone).

ScheduleRestriction.description: Quiet hours: local time windows when the alert is not checked.

InvestigationAgentEnabled.description: Run an investigation agent each time the alert fires (up to three times per firing episode); findings are written to a linked notebook.

InvestigationGatesNotifications.description: Hold the first notification of an episode until the investigation agent produces a verdict, and suppress it when the verdict is a false positive. Requires InvestigationAgentEnabled.

InvestigationInconclusiveAction.description: How to handle an inconclusive investigation verdict: `notify` (default) or `suppress`.

InsightShortId.description: Short ID of the monitored insight.
